translation: May the hands of Abū Lahab be ruined, and ruined is he.1

text: مَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُ مَالُهُۥ وَمَا كَسَبَ
translation: His wealth will not avail him or that which he gained.
He will [enter to] burn in a Fire of [blazing] flame
And his wife [as well] - the carrier of firewood.1
Around her neck is a rope of [twisted] fiber.
